Topics · The holy books together

Did Adam's sin pass to me?

In the Quran God turns to Adam and his wife. What is left to inherit? The Christian view, told fairly.

Part 1 of 3

﴿قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

Quran · Al-A'raf 7:23

Translation

Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

Original · Hebrew

חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי׃ הֶ֭רֶב כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃

the Psalms · 51:1-2

World English Bible

﴿فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words,[22] and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance,[23] the Merciful.

Translator's notes

[22] Allāh taught Adam words of repentance that would be acceptable to Him. [23] Literally, He who perpetually returns, i.e., reminding and enabling His servant to repent from sins and then forgiving him. Thus, He is also the constant motivator of the repentance He accepts.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:37

Translation

Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.

Original · Hebrew

קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ דְּבָרִ֔ים וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה אִמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כָּל־תִּשָּׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְקַח־ט֔וֹב וּֽנְשַׁלְּמָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ׃

Hosea · 14:2

World English Bible

For a debt to pass to the children, it must still stand when the father dies. So the first question is whether it stood. These verses tell what followed the eating from the tree: the two admitted they had wronged themselves and asked for forgiveness, then Adam received words and God turned to him. In the Quran the story does not end on the failure but on the return being accepted. What has been forgiven does not remain a debt to pass on.

A question for you

If the one you wronged forgives you, what is left after that?

If you sayNothing, it is finished
ThenThat is how the verses speak of a return accepted. It remains for you to compare it with what you were taught.
If you sayThe consequences remain
ThenThat matters. The earth is not the garden, and consequences can last. The question is whether a consequence is the same as guilt, and the next part separates the two.
If you sayA price must still be paid
ThenMillions of sincere Christians hold this, and a question of its own asks how God forgives without a sacrifice.

Part 2 of 3

﴿قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْغِى رَبًّا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۚ وَلَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not [blame] except against itself, and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ."

Quran · Al-An'am 6:164

Translation

The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

Original · Hebrew

הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א ׀ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֗ב וְאָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הַבֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַצַּדִּיק֙ עָלָ֣יו תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְרִשְׁעַ֥ת הָרָשָׁ֖ע עָלָ֥יו תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃

Ezekiel · 18:20

World English Bible

Suppose the guilt did remain. Could it travel? Guilt is not like money, for it belongs to a doer: you are guilty because you did it. This verse says it directly: no soul carries another soul's load. What can pass down is harm, wounds and surroundings. In the verse's terms, the guilt itself does not.

A question for you

What have you inherited from those before you: guilt, a wound, a tendency, or none of these?

If you sayA wound
ThenA wound is real, and you may grieve it; the verse does not deny that. It says the wound is not your guilt.
If you sayA leaning toward sin
ThenThis may be what many Christians mean. The Quran knows human frailty too. The question is whether that leaning is a verdict on you or a test for you.
If you sayGuilt
ThenThen you feel a real weight. Look closely: is it something you did, or something that came before you? The verse separates the two.

Part 3 of 3

﴿ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ١٢٢ قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ١٢٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him]. [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:122-123

Translation

I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

Original · Hebrew

שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־אֶמּֽוֹט׃

the Psalms · 16:8

World English Bible

If guilt is not inherited, what ties you to Adam? The verses offer another answer: what we received is a road, not a verdict. God chose Adam after his failure, turned to him and guided him. Then people came down to the earth with a promise: guidance will reach you from Me, and whoever follows it will not go astray. So each person begins where Adam began: able to fail, able to return, with the door straight ahead.

A question for you

What does it mean to you to begin life able to return?

The same in the other books

Translation

“In those days they will say no more, “‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’ But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.

For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
